title: Spec a story, then plan the retest of a change
prompt: Two things for our checkout team. First, write the acceptance criteria for this story: As a customer, I want to apply a promo code at checkout so that I pay less. A code can be used once per customer. An expired code shows "This code has expired." Gift cards are out of scope. Second, we shipped this change yesterday: promo codes now apply before shipping is calculated, and the old Coupon link in the footer is removed. What should we retest after that change?
agent: agy -p in an empty project outside the repository, with spec-writer, test-planner installed
answer:
## Acceptance criteria: Apply a promo code at checkout

Requirement: Customers can apply a promo code at checkout to pay less, limited to once per customer, with a specific message for expired codes and excluding gift cards.

### Main path
AC-1. Given a customer at checkout, when the customer applies a promo code, then the amount the customer pays is reduced. _As a customer, I want to apply a promo code at checkout so that I pay less._

### Validation and errors
AC-2. Given a customer at checkout with an expired promo code, when the customer applies the code, then the message "This code has expired." is shown. _An expired code shows "This code has expired."_

### Limits
AC-3. Given a customer who has already used a promo code, when the customer applies the same code again, then the code is refused. _A code can be used once per customer._

### Open questions
- [blocking] Main path: How is the discount calculated and which checkout amounts does it apply to? Blocks: AC-1
- [blocking] Limits: How is a customer identified to enforce the once-per-customer limit? Blocks: AC-3
- [minor] Validation and errors: What happens when a customer enters a promo code that does not exist? Validation and errors: What is shown to the customer when a reused promo code is refused?
- [minor] Limits: Can a customer apply more than one promo code during a single checkout? Main path: Can a customer remove a promo code after applying it?

### Out of scope
- Gift cards. _Gift cards are out of scope._

## Regression checklist: Promo code application order and footer Coupon link removal

Change: Promo codes now apply before shipping is calculated, and the old Coupon link in the footer is removed.

### promo codes
1. [ ] Apply a promo code and check the discount applies before shipping is calculated. _promo codes now apply before shipping is calculated_

### footer
2. [ ] Check the old Coupon link no longer appears in the footer. _the old Coupon link in the footer is removed_

### Possible impact, not stated
- Does applying promo codes before shipping affect tax calculation? The change text does not name it.
- Do order receipts or confirmation emails reflect the updated promo code and shipping order? The change text does not name it.
- Do any help pages or external bookmarks still point to the removed Coupon link destination? The change text does not name it.

### Open questions
- Should shipping rates be calculated on the discounted amount after a promo code is applied?
- Does anything replace the removed Coupon link in the footer, and what happens if a user visits its old URL?
